app.name: Super Mario Bros. 3
app.short_description: Cross the Mushroom World and stop Bowser.
app.long_description: Bowser's forces have overrun the Mushroom World, transformed its rulers, and stolen their magic wands. Guide Mario across the kingdoms and stop Bowser. Wii Remote held sideways: D-Pad moves, 1 runs, 2 jumps, + is NES Start, - is NES Select, HOME returns to the Homebrew Channel menu. Classic Controller or Pro: D-Pad moves, B or Y runs, A jumps, + is NES Start, - is NES Select, HOME returns to the Homebrew Channel menu. Place smb3.nes in the SD card root.
